data.title: 提丰 · 屋顶上一起等第一颗星
data.description: 晚饭后上屋顶透气，提丰穿原作猎装靠着矮栏杆。她抬手指向刚出现的星，随后回头确认你有没有看到；栏边两杯热可可并排放着，城市的暖窗光从下面亮起来。
data.action: 一手指向夜空初星，回头看同行的你
data.mood: 难得放松的惊喜与默契
data.promptProse: After dinner, Typhon leans on the low rooftop railing in her hunter outfit, pointing toward a newly visible star before glancing back at the viewer. Two cocoa cups sit together on the rail. The eye-level cowboy view opens over warm city windows. Blue-hour sky cools her hair and coat shoulders; the rooftop lamp warms her pointing fingers and both cup handles above the shadowed rooftop.
